PARAMS = {
    "w_tail": (2.0, 0.8, 6.0),
    "w_in":   (2.0, 0.8, 6.0),
    "w_ln":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),
    "w_lp":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),
    "w_rst":  (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),
    "w_invn": (0.6, 0.42, 2.0),
    "w_invp": (1.2, 0.42, 4.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    L = 0.15
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # tail switch (evaluate when clk high)
    n.M("Mtail", "tail", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_tail"], L)
    # input pair
    n.M("M1", "di1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    n.M("M2", "di2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["w_in"], L)
    # cross-coupled latch
    n.M("M3", "xa", "xb", "di1", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M4", "xb", "xa", "di2", "vss", "nfet", p["w_ln"], L)
    n.M("M5", "xa", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    n.M("M6", "xb", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_lp"], L)
    # reset switches (clk low -> precharge to VDD)
    n.M("MR1", "xa", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR2", "xb", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR3", "di1", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    n.M("MR4", "di2", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_rst"], L)
    # output inverters: xa falls when vinp>vinn -> outp rises
    n.M("MO1n", "outp", "xa", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_invn"], L)
    n.M("MO1p", "outp", "xa", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_invp"], L)
    n.M("MO2n", "outn", "xb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["w_invn"], L)
    n.M("MO2p", "outn", "xb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["w_invp"], L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 20e-15)
    cox_w = 1.0e-15  # ~F per um of gate/junction width (rough)
    c_x = cox_w * (p["w_ln"] + p["w_lp"] + p["w_rst"] + p["w_invn"] + p["w_invp"]) \
          + cox_w * 0.5 * (p["w_ln"] + p["w_lp"])
    c_di = cox_w * (0.6 * p["w_in"] + 0.6 * p["w_ln"] + 0.6 * p["w_rst"])
    try:
        on = lut.op("n", p["w_ln"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
        op = lut.op("p", p["w_lp"], L, 0.9, 0.6)
        gm_l = on["gm"] + op["gm"]
        oin = lut.op("n", p["w_in"], L, 0.9, 0.4)
        av = max(oin["gm_id"] * 0.3, 2.0)
    except Exception:
        gm_l, av = 4e-4, 4.0
    tau = c_x / max(gm_l, 1e-5)
    t_int = 2 * c_di * 0.7 / max(1e-4, 30e-6 * p["w_tail"] * 4)
    delay = t_int + tau * math.log(vdd / (av * spec["dv"])) + 40e-12 + cl * vdd / (2 * 300e-6 * p["w_invn"])
    c_sw = 2 * c_x + 2 * c_di + cox_w * p["w_tail"] + cl + cox_w * (p["w_invn"] + p["w_invp"])
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
